sn12.11:1.3: cattārome bhikkhave, āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya.
sn12.11:1.5: kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṃ catutthaṃ.
sn12.11:1.6: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā bhūtānaṃ vā sattānaṃ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṃ vā anuggahāya.
sn12.11:2.1: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā kinnidānā? kiṃsamudayā? kiñjātikā? kimpabhavā?
sn12.11:2.2: ime cattāro āhārā taṇhānidānā, taṇhāsamudayā, taṇhājātikā, taṇhāpabhavā
sn12.11:2.3: taṇhā cāyaṃ bhikkhave, kinnidānā? kiṃsamudayā? kiñjātikā? kimpabhavā?
sn12.11:2.5: vedanā cāyaṃ bhikkhave, kinnidānā? kiṃsamudayā? kiñjātikā? kimpabhavā?
sn12.11:2.7: phasso cāyaṃ bhikkhave, kinnidāno? kiṃsamudayo? kiñjātiko? kimpabhavo?
sn12.11:2.9: saḷāyatanañcidaṃ bhikkhave, kinnidānaṃ? kiṃsamudayaṃ? kiñjātikaṃ? kimpabhavaṃ?
sn12.11:2.11: nāmarūpañcidaṃ bhikkhave, kinnidānaṃ? kiṃsamudayaṃ? kiñjātikaṃ? kimpabhavaṃ?
sn12.11:2.13: viññāṇañcidaṃ bhikkhave, kinnidānaṃ? kiṃsamudayaṃ? kiñjātikaṃ? kimpabhavaṃ?
sn12.11:2.15: saṅkhārā cime bhikkhave, kinnidānā? kiṃsamudayā? kiñjātikā? kimpabhavā?
